notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product search + knowledge features) evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (quick POC) then moving to Dedicated if perf/cost targets met. Primary focus = embeddings + semantic search across product docs, KB, and user content.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Ava), agreed to hosted embeddings POC. Provided sample dataset (approx 1.2M short docs).
- 2026-01-25: Hosted API quickstart — ingestion + embeddings baseline run. Observed 2-3s end-to-end for naive batching (they were expecting faster).
- 2026-02-03: Technical deep-dive w/ SE (Daniel) — discussed vector DB topology (currently Pinecone managed + Elasticsearch for metadata). Need connector patterns.
- 2026-02-10: Dedicated architecture demo (Fireflies ff-20260210-haloquery-dedicated-deepdive). Ran through pooling/instance sizing and KV cache behavior for chat augmentation.
- 2026-02-22: Batch embedding job test (hosted) — baseline throughput ~40k docs/hr using current config. Goal 500k/day; asked for optimization guidance.
- 2026-03-05: Security paperwork submitted: SOC2 cert, DL for SSO/SAML, requested KMS/HSM options. Legal asked about data residency controls.
- 2026-03-10: Perf sync: running dedicated POC perf cluster next week, scheduled pricing review 2026-03-18.

Use-case & requirements (from Prod/Eng leads):
- Primary workload: semantic search over product docs + user notes; embedding index ~1–1.5M vectors now, expected 3–5M in 12 months.
- Targets: p95 retrieval latency <120ms at 300 qps for nearest-neighbor recall; tail latency critical for UX.
- Batch: nightly batch embeddings + backfill capability; target 500k docs/day or 50k docs/hr sustained during window.
- Throughput: peak query bursts up to 800 qps anticipated during feature launches; want graceful degradation and routing to cheaper model variant.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, aiming for total embedding + query cost to remain < $8k/month initially, with predictable reserve pricing for Dedicated.
- Vector DB: currently Pinecone managed; evaluating integration patterns with Milvus/Weaviate for on-prem futures. Need clear connector docs and example pipelines.
- Fallbacks: polyglot approach — hosted for dev, dedicated for prod with autoscale and burst.

Security & Compliance notes:
- Require SSO/SAML and audit logging for admin actions.
- KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated (customer key rotation policies).
- Data residency: primary US region, but EU residency for EU customers requested — legal contingency needed.

Quotes / call snippets:
- Head of Product: "If search recall slips above 120ms p95 at scale we will see churn — that is non-negotiable."
- Eng lead: "Batch pipeline must handle 500k docs/day; if hosted can't hit that we need clear migration path to Dedicated."

POC specifics / success criteria:
- Hosted POC (complete): ingest 1.2M small docs, produce embeddings; measure baseline CPU/GPU utilization and per-embedding cost.
- Dedicated POC (in progress): replicate same dataset, run 72-hour steady-state perf test at 300 qps + 800 qps burst; validate p95 latency <120ms, KV/prefix cache efficacy, and autoscale policy behavior.
- Vector DB integration test: run retrievals via Pinecone + direct Milvus proof-of-concept; measure end-to-end recall and 99th percentile tail.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Pricing model for reserved burst capacity and how it scales with vector DB egress.
- Best-practice configs for 1–5M vector indexes to meet <120ms p95.
- Example IaC templates for VPC peering + KMS (customer-managed).

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-18: Pricing deep-dive with finance + product (internal invite).
- Finish 72-hr dedicated perf run and share traces/dashboards (Ava/Dan to collect).
- Provide Milvus connector example and cost estimate for on-prem option.

Notes on decision process / stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: VP of Finance (watching ARR impact).
- Technical buyer: Head of Engineering + Head of Product (care most about latency + scale).
- Legal/security: legal + info-sec team needs residency/KMS answers before procurement.

Other artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive (linked). Jira tickets open for infra tuning (RDW-3421) and onboard checklist (RDW-3550).

Short-term risks: hosted POC perf below target -> delays; legal residency clause may push to Dedicated earlier than expected.

Chatter: Notes are intentionally choppy — AE/SE shorthand. Follow-up cadence: 1x/week until pricing/POC closed.
